cases.title: One claim copied to three repositories
cases.setup: Repo B and Repo C copy the same proposition from Repo A.

cases.title: Twenty features from one waveform
cases.setup: Twenty derived features are computed from one measured waveform.

cases.title: Summary plus original document
cases.setup: A semantic summary and the exact source passage both support one claim.

cases.title: Privacy projection plus raw source
cases.setup: A privacy-minimized projection and the inaccessible raw source are both cited.

cases.title: Different agents same model and context
cases.setup: Five agents use the same model version, instructions, retrieval corpus, and prompt ancestry.

cases.title: Different models with unknown training overlap
cases.setup: Two providers produce similar answers but relevant training/source overlap cannot be determined.

cases.title: Independent measurements with separate custody
cases.setup: Two physically separate instruments, clocks, operators, calibration chains, and source records measure the same external event with no known shared claim-relevant acquisition root.

cases.title: Two articles copy one press release
cases.setup: Two websites repeat the same press release content.

cases.title: Later timestamp treated as cause
cases.setup: Artifact B is created after Artifact A with no provenance edge.

cases.title: Old review applied to child head
cases.setup: Review PASS is bound to parent commit; child changes reviewed files.

cases.title: Correction preserves predecessor
cases.setup: A later interpretation corrects an earlier one while retaining both artifacts and a SUPERSEDES edge.

cases.title: Correction deletes predecessor
cases.setup: System replaces the old interpretation in place and removes the old evidence path.

cases.title: Translation of source
cases.setup: Translated text is cited as if independent from the original language source.

cases.title: Aggregate from three independent roots
cases.setup: A report aggregates three independently acquired source families and records all parents.

cases.title: Self-parent artifact
cases.setup: Artifact declares itself as its own DERIVED_FROM parent.

cases.title: Two-node provenance cycle
cases.setup: A DERIVED_FROM B and B DERIVED_FROM A.

cases.title: Unknown provenance edge
cases.setup: Artifact uses a parent edge called INSPIRED_BY with no declared ancestry semantics.

cases.title: Retrieved source reused in model output
cases.setup: A retrieved passage is fed to a model that restates it in a new answer.

cases.title: Memory reconstructed from summary
cases.setup: A durable memory is created from a prior summary rather than original evidence.

cases.title: Same dataset, different analyses
cases.setup: Two teams use the same underlying dataset with independent code and analysts.

cases.title: Exact evidence span lacks version binding
cases.setup: Excerpt has text and digest but no exact source version/reference.

cases.title: Derived artifact lacks transform identity
cases.setup: Feature vector lists a parent but no procedure/version/parameter digest.

cases.title: Opaque private source with safe digest
cases.setup: Private payload remains outside God Brain; graph stores opaque ID, safe digest, privacy class, and derivation edge.

cases.title: Latest artifact assumed current authority
cases.setup: Newest timestamped record is treated as current authority despite a currentness rule requiring fresh readback.
